description: Church App Enhancements - Flutter Internationalization (i18n) and Schema-Driven Development

userStories.title: Add Flutter Localization Dependencies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to add the required localization packages so the app can support multiple languages.
acceptanceCriteria: Add flutter_localizations to pubspec.yaml dependencies (sdk: flutter)
Verify intl: ^0.19.0 is present (it is)
Run flutter pub get successfully
flutter analyze passes with no errors

userStories.title: Configure Flutter Localization in MaterialApp
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to configure the MaterialApp to support localization delegates and supported locales.
acceptanceCriteria: Update lib/main.dart to add localizationsDelegates
Add supportedLocales for English (en) and Vietnamese (vi)
Configure localeResolutionCallback to default to English if locale not supported
App builds and runs without errors
flutter analyze passes

userStories.title: Create ARB File Structure and Generate Localization Classes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to set up the ARB translation files and configure code generation for localized strings.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/l10n/ directory
Create app_en.arb with initial translatable strings (app title, navigation labels)
Create app_vi.arb with Vietnamese translations
Add generate: true and l10n configuration to pubspec.yaml
Create l10n.yaml configuration file
Run flutter gen-l10n successfully
flutter analyze passes

userStories.title: Create Schemas Directory Structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a dedicated directory for JSON schema definitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /schemas directory at project root
Create README.md in schemas/ explaining the schema structure and usage
flutter analyze passes (no impact on Flutter code)

userStories.title: Define Event JSON Schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a JSON Schema definition for the Event model to serve as the single source of truth.
acceptanceCriteria: Create schemas/event.schema.json
Schema follows JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 specification
Schema includes all Event fields: id, name, date, location, description, imageUrl
Schema defines required vs optional fields
Schema includes field types and validation rules
userStories.notes: Review existing lib/data/models/event.dart for field reference

userStories.title: Define Discipleship Course JSON Schemas
userStories.description: As a developer, I need JSON Schema definitions for Discipleship-related models (Course, Location, Class).
acceptanceCriteria: Create schemas/discipleship_course.schema.json
Schema includes Course model fields (id, name, isActive, etc.)
Schema includes nested Location type
Schema includes nested Class type (classNumber, passage, date, notes)
Schema defines required vs optional fields
userStories.notes: Review existing lib/data/models/discipleship_data.dart for field reference

userStories.title: Add Code Generation Scripts and Documentation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need scripts to generate Dart code from schemas and documentation on how to use them.
acceptanceCriteria: Create scripts/generate-models.sh script
Script uses quicktype to generate Dart from JSON Schema
Create docs/schema-development.md with usage instructions
Update project README to reference schema documentation
Shell script is executable (chmod +x)
userStories.notes: quicktype can be installed via npm: npm install -g quicktype

userStories.title: Generate Base Dart Models from Schemas
userStories.description: As a developer, I want Dart model classes generated from JSON schemas so I don't maintain them manually.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/data/models/generated/ directory
Running generate script creates event_generated.dart
Running generate script creates discipleship_course_generated.dart
Generated classes include fromJson() and toJson() methods
Generated classes have null-safe types based on schema required fields
flutter analyze passes on generated code

userStories.title: Integrate Generated Models with Existing Code
userStories.description: As a developer, I want existing model classes to extend or use the generated base classes.
acceptanceCriteria: Update lib/data/models/event.dart to use generated base or verify compatibility
Update lib/data/models/discipleship_data.dart to use generated types
Ensure Firestore serialization still works correctly
All existing functionality continues to work
flutter analyze passes
App builds and runs successfully
